name: MathVista: Evaluating Mathematical Reasoning of Foundation Models in Visual Contexts
description: MathVista is a premier benchmark for evaluating mathematical reasoning of multimodal foundation models within visual contexts. Created by UCLA, University of Washington, and Microsoft Research, it gathers 6,141 diverse mathematical visual problems requiring visual perception, arithmetic reasoning, geometry, logic puzzles, and scientific chart comprehension across grade-school to university difficulty.
